name: Portalrubio de Guadamejud (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Portalrubio de Guadamejud (waves, a cross of Calatrava and a crozier).
history: Municipal flag of Portalrubio de Guadamejud; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Portalrubio de Guadamejud arms — waves, cross of Calatrava and crozier
